name: The Who

whyMatters.en: London four-piece formed in 1964. Power-chord singles, Townshend concept albums (Tommy, Who’s Next), and a loud live setup with Moon’s drums and Entwistle’s bass.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组，1964 年成立。强力和弦单曲、Townshend 概念专集（《Tommy》《Who’s Next》），以及 Moon 的鼓与 Entwistle 的贝斯构成的大音量现场编制。

note.en: 1965 single; Daltrey stutter vocal, feedback, Entwistle bass solo.
note.zh: 1965 单曲；Daltrey 口吃人声、反馈、Entwistle 贝斯独奏。

note.en: From Who’s Next; Lowrey organ/sequencer intro into power-chord sections.
note.zh: 出自《Who’s Next》；Lowrey 风琴/音序引入接入强力和弦段落。

interviewQuotes.text: Rock is art and the stuff of life.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Pete Townshend

interviewQuotes.text: Keith played the drums like a lead instrument. We arranged around that.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Pete Townshend

lyricQuotes: I hope I die before I get old
People try to put us d-down / Just because we get around

shortBio.en: London hard rock, 1964–. Townshend, Daltrey, Entwistle, Moon; My Generation and Who’s Next are core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦硬摇滚，1964 年至今。Townshend、Daltrey、Entwistle、Moon；《My Generation》与《Who’s Next》是主要参照。

body.en:
The Who formed in London in 1964. Mid-60s singles such as My Generation used stutter vocals, feedback, and Entwistle’s bass breaks. Tommy (1969) set a rock-opera album scale; Who’s Next (1971) used synthesizer and organ/sequencer parts on Baba O’Riley and Won’t Get Fooled Again.

Moon’s drums and Entwistle’s melodic bass are the clearest instrumental signatures. High stage volume and instrument-smashing incidents appear in contemporary reports of the live shows.
body.zh:
The Who 于 1964 年在伦敦成立。60 年代中期单曲如《My Generation》使用口吃人声、反馈与 Entwistle 的贝斯打断。《Tommy》（1969）确立摇滚歌剧式专辑尺度；《Who’s Next》（1971）在《Baba O’Riley》《Won’t Get Fooled Again》上使用合成器与风琴/音序声部。

Moon 的鼓与 Entwistle 的旋律贝斯是最易辨认的乐器特征。大音量舞台与砸乐器事件见诸当时现场报道。

body.en:
Townshend’s writing centers on power chords, clear verse/chorus shapes, and, on later albums, longer narrative forms.

Moon often plays fills as a lead-like drum part; Entwistle’s bass takes melodic solos. Daltrey carries the vocal line, including the stutter phrasing on My Generation.
body.zh:
Townshend 的写作以强力和弦、清楚的主歌/副歌结构为主，后期专辑则加入更长的叙事形式。

Moon 常以接近主奏的加花打鼓；Entwistle 的贝斯承担旋律独奏。Daltrey 负责人声线，包括《My Generation》上的口吃句式。

body.en:
Released as a single in 1965. Daltrey’s stuttered vocal, guitar feedback, and Entwistle’s bass solo are the main identifiers.

The track sits in the mid-60s mod/beat singles market and keeps a fast tempo with a shouted chorus.
body.zh:
1965 年作为单曲发行。Daltrey 的口吃人声、吉他反馈与 Entwistle 的贝斯独奏是主要识别元素。

歌曲属于 60 年代中期 mod/beat 单曲市场，节奏快，副歌偏喊唱。

body.en:
From Who’s Next (1971). A Lowrey organ part processed through a synthesizer/sequencer opens the track, then full-band power chords enter.

Daltrey’s long final scream and Townshend’s guitar are central live markers. Baba O’Riley, from the same album, uses a similar organ/sequencer-to-band layout.
body.zh:
出自《Who’s Next》（1971）。Lowrey 风琴经合成器/音序处理后开场，再接入全乐队强力和弦。

Daltrey 末尾长啸与 Townshend 的吉他是现场主要标记。同专辑的《Baba O’Riley》也使用类似的风琴/音序接入全乐队结构。

body.en:
Later hard-rock bands often cite the loud live arrangement—Moon’s drums, Entwistle’s bass, Townshend’s power chords.

Tommy and Quadrophenia are frequent citations for concept/rock-opera album writing in progressive and narrative rock.
body.zh:
后来的 hard rock 乐队常引用其大音量现场编制——Moon 的鼓、Entwistle 的贝斯、Townshend 的强力和弦。

《Tommy》与《Quadrophenia》常被 progressive 与叙事摇滚引用为概念/摇滚歌剧式专辑写法。

body.en:
Townshend has described arranging around Moon’s drums as a lead instrument. That matches how fills and bass lines share space with the vocal on the classic-four records.

Instrument damage onstage is documented separately in press accounts of the period.
body.zh:
Townshend 曾描述围绕 Moon 的鼓作为主奏乐器来编曲。这与经典四人组唱片上加花、贝斯线与人声共用空间的做法一致。

舞台砸乐器则另见于当时媒体报道。

note.en: Stutter vocal, feedback, and Entwistle bass solo on a 1965 single.
note.zh: 1965 单曲上的口吃人声、反馈与 Entwistle 贝斯独奏。

note.en: Power-chord singles and concept albums (Tommy, Who’s Next) in one classic lineup.
note.zh: 同一经典阵容下的强力和弦单曲与概念专集（《Tommy》《Who’s Next》）。

note.en: Townshend, Daltrey, Entwistle, Moon through Who Are You; Moon died in 1978.
note.zh: Townshend、Daltrey、Entwistle、Moon，至《Who Are You》；Moon 于 1978 年去世。
